scripts.preversion: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && npm test
scripts.version: git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: release telemetry contract v${npm_new_version}" && git tag "$(npm config get tag-version-prefix)${npm_new_version}"
scripts.postversion: git push --atomic origin HEAD "refs/tags/$(npm config get tag-version-prefix)${npm_new_version}"
